canonical.title: Special-character lodging within taxi range of d'Eugénie à Émilie

parent.title: A weekend in Baudour, anchored on dinner at d'Eugénie à Émilie

siblings.title: Day-trips and activities within 30 km of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Pairi Daiza for a full day, Mons in a half-day, Grand-Hornu next door — what to drive to around Baudour, ranked by distance and pay-off.

siblings.title: Walking-distance lodging at or near d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: Triple E — the Fernez family's three-room boutique inn directly across the square — is the only real walk-home bed; everything else is a 3 km+ taxi.

siblings.title: IT conferences and tech events within 30 km of d'Eugénie à Émilie
siblings.summary: The 30 km bubble around Baudour is anchored on Mons — Le CLICK and the Initialis science park host the flagships (DevDay 3 Dec, DevFest 27 Nov, Forum Innovation & Cloud); Valenciennes's Serre Numérique grazes the edge.

sources.title: visitmons.be — Cense de Lalouette
sources.claim: Cense de Lalouette is an 18th-century farm fully renovated, located in Saint-Ghislain between Mons and Tournai, originally built by the Spanish as a post-relay station

sources.title: visitwallonia.com — Sleep in a church
sources.claim: Martin's Dream Hotel is built within the walls of a former neo-Gothic chapel/convent of the Sisters of Belian Abbey in Mons centre

sources.title: monsdragonhouse.be
sources.claim: Mons Dragon House features five themed rooms (Belfry, Golden Chariot, Doudou, Dragon, Canonesses) each designed by a different local Mons designer

sources.title: pairidaiza.eu — Resort
sources.claim: Pairi Daiza Resort has 209 themed lodge accommodations, and the new Edenya wing adds 88 accommodations including underwater hotel rooms for 2026

sources.title: visitmons.be — d'Eugénie à Émilie
sources.claim: d'Eugénie à Émilie is located at 1 Place de la Résistance, 7331 Baudour

sources.title: L'Avenir — Michelin 2026 Wallonia
sources.claim: d'Eugénie à Émilie retains its two Michelin stars in the 2026 guide

sources.title: Gault & Millau — d'Eugénie à Émilie
sources.claim: d'Eugénie à Émilie was temporarily closed for renovation, with a reopening targeted toward the end of February 2026; rated 17.5/20 by Gault & Millau

sources.title: rome2rio — Mons → Baudour
sources.claim: The fastest route Mons → Baudour is by taxi, taking ~13 minutes and costing $35–$45

sources.title: TaxiProxi — Baudour fares
sources.claim: Local taxi services (TaxiProxi) operate in Baudour with online fare calculation and booking

sources.title: meetinhainaut.be — Cense de Lalouette
sources.claim: Cense de Lalouette's street address is 188 Rue de Tournai, 7333 Saint-Ghislain (Tertre)

sources.title: Booking — Cense de Lalouette gîte
sources.claim: Cense de Lalouette offers six independent apartment-gîtes accommodating 2–6 people each, with private courtyard, equipped kitchens and weekly housekeeping

sources.title: Martin's Hotels — Dream rooms
sources.claim: Martin's Dream Hotel offers 62 themed rooms (Belgian flavours, Carnival of Binche, the five continents) plus a Cinq Mondes spa with hammam, sauna and jacuzzi

sources.title: Martin's Dream Hotel — overview
sources.claim: Martin's Dream Hotel sits at 17 Rue de la Grande Triperie, Mons 7000, in a 19th-century neo-Gothic building, and joined Martin's Hotels in 2019

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Mons Dragon House
sources.claim: Mons Dragon House reviewers praise the Doudou room and a 1-minute walk to the Grand-Place; rooms are spacious with playful construction

sources.title: visitmons.be — Hôtel Saint-James
sources.claim: Hôtel Saint-James occupies an 18th-century residence with 21 rooms around an inner courtyard, less than 10 minutes' walk from Mons Grand-Place

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Hôtel Infotel
sources.claim: Hôtel Infotel is housed in an 18th-century mansion 60 m south of Mons Grand-Place; reviews are mixed on cleanliness and ageing rooms in the older wing

sources.title: Tripadvisor — L'Écureuil
sources.claim: L'Écureuil in Frameries is a 2-room guesthouse, ranked #1 specialty lodging in Frameries on Tripadvisor; ~10 min from Mons and 400 m from SPARK'OH

sources.title: Gîtes de Wallonie — Les Peupliers
sources.claim: Les Peupliers is a 3-room B&B in a renovated farmhouse in Erbisœul (Jurbise), 8 km from Mons, with heated outdoor pool (27°C May–Sept) and sauna

sources.title: Pairi Daiza — Walrus House
sources.claim: Pairi Daiza's Walrus House has 6 rooms each offering an underwater view into the walrus habitat

sources.title: Pairi Daiza press — 4k stays in 24h
sources.claim: Pairi Daiza Resort logged 4,000 stays booked in 24 hours during a recent release, with Saturday/Sunday underwater rooms selling out the fastest

sources.title: Tripadvisor — Pairi Daiza Resort
sources.claim: Some Pairi Daiza Resort guests warn that views fail to deliver — one €800 polar-bear room showed a pump rather than a bear
